title: Bad extension fiber
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates and let $\eta$ be a coordinate restriction. The bad extension fiber consists of all bad restrictions $\rho$ whose image under the bad-extension map of $\varphi$ is $\eta$.
caveat: The snippet uses the bad-extension map but does not include its definition, so the map’s mathematical meaning cannot be stated more explicitly.
